what: Compact summary of the third holdout, which measured whether the classifier could create canonical graph nodes unsupervised. It could not. The full record - 440 rendered cards, the answer key, the per-card verdicts, the seal and the 1,619-line audit - is on the research branch, referenced below rather than copied: merging 34,000 lines of evidence for a rejected strategy alongside the mechanism that replaces it buries the thing that needs reviewing.
verdict: REJECTED. The gate is NOT MET.

review.howIsolated: freshly spawned, disjoint 110-card subsets, cards copied out of the repository, verbatim instructions, no feedback between batches, no reviewer saw another's work
review.caveat: independent AGENTS, not independent people. A real improvement on the kappa 0.847 intra-rater pass, and not human expert ground truth.

conditions.name: unreviewableCountedAsFailures
conditions.requirement: the bound above must be computed with unreviewable cards counted as failures

promotionGate.detail: n=350: 314 confirmed, 32 contradicted, 4 unreviewable. Lower 95% bound 86.1% counting unreviewable as failures, 87.2% excluding them. NOT MET: zeroConfirmedNotAJunctionFalsePositives, lowerBound95OnAtGradePrecision.

permissiveSideFabricatesJunctions.note: JUNCTION_WITNESS is the ONLY HIGH-confidence at-grade rule - the one backed by positive evidence rather than by the absence of contrary evidence.

whyMoreThresholdsWouldNotHelp.conclusion: Both errors are large AT THE SAME SETTINGS. Tightening the at-grade rules withdraws more real junctions; loosening the withdrawal rules creates more false nodes. That rejects the approach, not the parameters.

nationalConsequenceAvoided.note: roughly one in eleven, each joining a road to itself or to nothing, in a tool whose purpose is to say which roads matter when one closes

whatShipsInstead: Evidence-backed overrides only. See PIVOT.md and nzcl/overrides.py. The classifier survives as a candidate-RANKING score and must never directly create a canonical node.
readingTheNumbers: Performance on a deliberately difficult, stratified holdout. This is not a probability sample and is not an estimate or formal lower bound on national precision. The Wilson bound applies to this holdout's reviewed cases, not to a nationally weighted population.
